issues.why: Unnatural phrasing. 'интеграцтай' (with integration) is a more natural and common construction than the verbal adjective 'интеграцчилсан' (integrated) in this context.
Unnatural terminology. In UI/software context, 'харагдац' (view/appearance) is the correct term for 'reader view', whereas 'харуулалт' means 'showing' or 'display'.
